en: This postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a group of men and women, dressed in work clothes and headscarves, sitting together outside on what appears to be a wooden platform in an industrial or agricultural setting. The reverse side contains handwritten script in Swedish, with addressed details and a date marked as 1922. There is also some metadata at the bottom noting 'Sundsvalls museum.'
